A '''security lock''' or '''securilock'''<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> was a device that restricted access to areas of importance. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] extensively employed security locks. Security locks opened when the proper code was entered usually issued via a [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]] that used a [[Scomp link/Legends|scomp link]], though some locks allowed users to enter the code manually. Other security locks used retinal, fingerprint, or voice scans to confirm an individual's identity. [[Electronic lock breaker/Legends|Electronic lock breakers]], [[anti-security blade]]s, and [[Electro-shock prod/Legends|electroshock probes]] were some of only tools that could fool a security lock.

Security locks included a [[wetter plate]], and were partially made from [[boreen]].<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>
